problems.problem: The regenerated steel field still carries a broad vertical softbox-style bright column at top center (visible from y=0 fading to ~y=500) despite the prompt forbidding vertical streaks; it fights the declared cool diffuse even illumination, contradicts the horizontal mist-band logic, and pulls the eye into the empty upper frame instead of toward the bottle or the type column.

Product bbox [73,641,575,1145] gives a height ratio of 0.35, at the floor of the allowed 35-74% band for this concept; the top 44% of canvas is unmodulated steel with no tonal event, so the frame reads as an under-scaled packshot in dead space versus references 3 and 5 where the hero or its atmosphere commands the frame. The previous scale-up patch was rejected, so a corrected in-bounds geometry must be supplied.

The right column holds only PRADA (y684-703), Paradoxe (y792-846) and the peach rule at y1010; subtitle and price are empty strings, leaving a void from the rule to the canvas bottom and denying the layered brand/name/descriptor hierarchy references 3 and 5 use to hold negative space. The previous subtitle patch was rejected on validation, so it must be re-issued with geometry that fits the column.

Contact detail crop [0,1005,655,1255] confirms the base meets the steel with a soft shadow at offset_y 0 (no floating), but the shadow remains a thin uniform smudge under the base run with no occlusion gradient stretching into the brushed grain and no faint metal reflection, so the glass still reads as a cutout placed on metal rather than standing in it; the baked upper-left key is also unanswered by any directional bias in the contact.

References resolve their scenes with atmospheric density (007 petals), a reflective ground plane (Cartier, Versace) or a controlled gradient; this poster offers flat brushed texture plus one glow line and a stray vertical streak, so the 'metal climate' concept is stated but not built to campaign density.
